brief: make a board with USB C PD power input to an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 that drives a 64x32 p2.5 HUB75 display. Include header outputs for driving addressable LED string and a speaker.

intent.goal: Build a USB-C Power Delivery-powered board around an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 to drive a 64×32 P2.5 HUB75 display, with header outputs for an addressable LED string and a speaker.
constraints: Header outputs for an addressable LED string and a speaker
assumptions: USB-C PD voltage and power profile are unspecified (defaulted)
HUB75 display and speaker are external loads; the addressable LED string uses WS2812-compatible signaling (defaulted)

blocks.name: USB_C_PD_INPUT
blocks.purpose: Accept USB-C Power Delivery input and provide board operating power.

blocks.name: ESP32_S3_PROCESSOR
blocks.purpose: Run application logic and generate display, LED, and speaker control signals.

blocks.name: HUB75_DISPLAY_INTERFACE
blocks.purpose: Provide the HUB75 signals and connector for the external 64×32 P2.5 display.

blocks.name: ADDRESSABLE_LED_OUTPUT
blocks.purpose: Provide WS2812-compatible signaling through a header to an external addressable LED string.

blocks.name: SPEAKER_OUTPUT
blocks.purpose: Provide a header output for an external speaker.

connections.description: Power for the processor and board logic
Display data, row address, and control signals

assumptions: The display and speaker are externally powered loads; the board provides their signals but does not supply their load power (defaulted)
The speaker header carries a drive signal suitable for external speaker-driving equipment rather than directly powering a speaker (defaulted)
